photos.title: The Carolinian Beach Resort from above
photos.what: The Carolinian Beach Resort from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): a white tower with a blue roof piece and a blue pool stands on the beach in the middle; Ocean Boulevard runs along its landward side; the sand and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: The Carolinian from above, on the beach, with the Atlantic Ocean beyond the sand.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Carolinian Beach Resort, a white oceanfront tower in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean beside it
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
